comparison.objective: Place stoppings correctly on a mine-ventilation plan so both faces receive airflow; candidate physically breaks and collects HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Discrete plan-piece placement and airflow-layout reasoning do not test tool alignment, impact control, fracture, or fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Each district has all outby crosscuts sealed while its last crosscut and entries remain open; candidate requires four physical fractures, four recovered fragments, and no damage.
comparison.reason: This is a configuration/reasoning task rather than impact-driven assembly finishing.
